title: Taco Salad
equipment: Small zip-top bag (for the sour cream lines)

items: 1 lb lean ground beef (85–90% lean) or ground turkey
1 tsp neutral oil (only if using turkey)
1 large head romaine or iceberg lettuce (about 8 cups), shredded
1 cup guacamole, or 2 ripe avocados, diced

steps: Stir the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika and salt together in a small bowl.

Heat a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Add the meat (and the oil if using turkey). Cook 6–8 min, breaking it into small crumbles, until no pink remains. Beef should read 160°F and turkey 165°F.
Tip the pan and spoon off most of the fat. Lower the heat to medium. Stir in the seasoning and ¼ cup water and simmer 2–3 min, until the liquid is mostly gone and the meat looks glossy.
While the meat cooks, shred the lettuce and dice the tomatoes and avocado. Divide the lettuce among 4 plates or bowls.
Spoon the warm meat over the lettuce. Add the cheddar, tomatoes and guacamole or avocado.
Spoon the sour cream into a small zip-top bag, snip off a tiny corner and pipe it over each salad in lines. Serve with salsa on the side.
tips: Keep the meat and lettuce apart until you eat. Warm meat wilts lettuce fast.
Add crushed tortilla chips or a can of rinsed black beans for crunch and bulk.
Make a triple batch of the seasoning and keep it in a jar. Use 5 tsp per 1 lb of meat.
storage: Cooked meat keeps in the fridge up to 4 days or the freezer up to 3 months. Keep the lettuce and toppings separate. Reheat the meat in a skillet over medium heat with a splash of water, or in the microwave, until hot. Assembled salads do not keep.
